title: Ledger event
description: One line in the visitor's append-only ledger (framework/ledger.js). Events are never edited or deleted; derived state (what was seen, finished, unlocked, best scores) is computed by replaying them.

id.description: Unique within the ledger: <ts in base 36>-<counter>-<random>.

ts.description: Milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC, from the visitor's clock.

entity.description: An entity ID from the registry (<type>:<slug>).

payload.description: Small, verb-specific data. 'scored' needs a numeric value. Rituals never emit 'scored' (see ritual.schema.json framing).
